brief:
Gaza's municipalities warn that winter rains pose a severe threat to roughly 1,000 shelter sites across the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. About 200,000 tents require replacement to withstand the seasonal weather, according to local councils. The deteriorating conditions affect hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians sheltering in makeshift camps.

The European Union has urged Israel to reopen all border crossings to allow humanitarian aid into Gaza. The appeal comes as winter weather compounds existing hardships facing the displaced population already struggling with shortages of basic supplies and services.
dek: About 200,000 tents need replacing, Gaza’s municipalities say, as the EU urges Israel to reopen all crossings.
title: Winter rains threaten Gaza shelter sites as 200,000 tents need replacement
